title: Coherent geometric comparisons for component lifts
statement: Let Lambda be a commutative condensed ring and S an extremally disconnected profinite space. With the definitions of [def-sfb-component-lift-section-data], there exist coefficient data d(T,e), derived monoidal structures m(T,e), and comparisons c(g):F_U followed by g^* ≅ F_V for every component-preserving map of affine w-contractible lifts of S. For each g the comparison is induced by a projection-preserving natural isomorphism of the actual relative test functors, by an ordinary module comparison satisfying ComponentLiftInducedComparison, and c is exactly its componentLiftDerivedComparison. Each c satisfies ComponentLiftMonoidal. Each d satisfies ComponentLiftEquivalence. For W→V→U, c(g) followed by c(h), under the specified leftDerivedUpperStarComp, equals c(hg) on every object. This is the geometric construction and coherence alone; it asserts no section bijection or finite-free duality.

proof.text: For a finite clopen subdivision $S_i\to S$, the inverse image of each clopen part of $U$ under $g$ is the corresponding part of $V$, because $\pi_0(g)=1_S$. Thus $V\times_U(U\times_S S_i)$ is the indicated disjoint union of clopen parts of $V$. Pass to the defining affine limits for $E=\varprojlim_i S_i$. Explicitly, a map from a scheme $W$ to $V\times_U\varprojlim_i(U\times_S S_i)$ is a map $W\to V$ and a compatible family of maps to $U\times_S S_i$ with that composite to $U$; this is precisely a compatible family of maps to $V\times_S S_i$. The two universal properties give the claimed projection-preserving isomorphism. The same description shows naturality in $E$, and for a second morphism $h$ both successive and direct comparisons have the same projections, hence agree. The component-site construction therefore gives $\pi_U\circ g\cong\pi_V$. Its coefficient maps agree since each is pulled back from the condensed point. Apply the ringed-derived monoidal comparisons to this specified 2-isomorphism: it gives $c:g^*\pi_U^*\cong\pi_V^*$, preserving the coefficient unit and composition. Uniqueness of the projection-preserving test comparison proves composition; taking the adjunction mate gives the ordinary comparison with the displayed unit equation, and localization gives exactly componentLiftDerivedComparison.

lean.statement:
theorem component_lift_geometric_comparisons
    (Λ : Profinite.CondensedRing.{u}) [IsCommMonObj Λ.X]
    (S : Profinite.{u}) [ExtremallyDisconnected S] :
    ∃ d : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine T] [IsWContractibleRing Γ(T, ⊤)]
        (e : affineComponentSpace T ≃ₜ S), ComponentLiftCoefficient Λ S T e,
      ∃ m : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine T] [IsWContractibleRing Γ(T, ⊤)]
          (e : affineComponentSpace T ≃ₜ S), (componentLiftDerived (d T e)).Monoidal,
        ∃ c : ∀ (U V : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine U] [IsAffine V]
            [IsWContractibleRing Γ(U, ⊤)] [IsWContractibleRing Γ(V, ⊤)]
            (eU : affineComponentSpace U ≃ₜ S) (eV : affineComponentSpace V ≃ₜ S)
            (g : V ⟶ U), IsComponentLiftMap eU eV g →
            ((componentLiftDerived (d U eU) ⋙ moduleObjectDerivedPullback Λ.X g) ≅
              componentLiftDerived (d V eV)),
          (∀ (U V : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine U] [IsAffine V]
            [IsWContractibleRing Γ(U, ⊤)] [IsWContractibleRing Γ(V, ⊤)]
            (eU : affineComponentSpace U ≃ₜ S) (eV : affineComponentSpace V ≃ₜ S)
            (g : V ⟶ U) (hg : IsComponentLiftMap eU eV g),
            (∃ k : componentLiftTests V S eV ≅ componentLiftTests U S eU ⋙
                MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @WeaklyEtale ⊤ g,
              (∀ (E : Over S) (v : ((componentLiftTests V S eV).obj E).left),
                (d U eU).projection E
                  (pullback.fst ((componentLiftTests U S eU).obj E).hom g
                    ((k.app E).hom.left v)) = (d V eV).projection E v) ∧
              ∃ q : componentLiftModules (d U eU) ⋙ upperStar Λ.X g ≅
                  componentLiftModules (d V eV),
                ComponentLiftInducedComparison (d U eU) (d V eV) g k q ∧
                c U V eU eV g hg =
                  componentLiftDerivedComparison (d U eU) (d V eV) g q) ∧
            ComponentLiftMonoidal (m U eU) (m V eV) (c U V eU eV g hg)) ∧
          (∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine T] [IsWContractibleRing Γ(T, ⊤)]
            (e : affineComponentSpace T ≃ₜ S), ComponentLiftEquivalence (d T e)) ∧
          (∀ (U V W : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine U] [IsAffine V] [IsAffine W]
            [IsWContractibleRing Γ(U, ⊤)] [IsWContractibleRing Γ(V, ⊤)]
            [IsWContractibleRing Γ(W, ⊤)]
            (eU : affineComponentSpace U ≃ₜ S) (eV : affineComponentSpace V ≃ₜ S)
            (eW : affineComponentSpace W ≃ₜ S) (g : V ⟶ U) (h : W ⟶ V)
            (hg : IsComponentLiftMap eU eV g) (hh : IsComponentLiftMap eV eW h)
            (hc : IsComponentLiftMap eU eW (h ≫ g))
            (N : Evaluation.D ((coherentTopology Profinite.{u}).over S)
              (profiniteCoefficient Λ.X S)),
            (leftDerivedUpperStarComp Λ.X h g).hom.app ((componentLiftDerived (d U eU)).obj N) ≫
              (moduleObjectDerivedPullback Λ.X h).map ((c U V eU eV g hg).hom.app N) ≫
              (c V W eV eW h hh).hom.app N = (c U W eU eW (h ≫ g) hc).hom.app N)
